_comment: SNOW REPEAT-SINK EXTRAS vs THE PLAN'S OWED ACTIVATIONS (MTG_REPEAT_EXTRAS_RESERVE, 2026-11-13; from Snow seed 61066
gi 66 T5 main 2, the board after Jorn's attack untapped it). Rimefeather Owl's '{1}{S}: ice counter' is a {T}-less
repeatable sink: a plan asking for it K times carries ONE activation on the subset's books and the K-1 extras are
paid at apply out of what is left. Snow's activation order runs the Owl before the tap-draws, so the search's
[Scrying Sheets(act), Rimefeather Owl(act)x3] (books: 4 of 6 non-Sheets mana) spent all six on three Owl
activations and the Sheets look came up unpaid -- the committed plan was not the line played. With the lever
the extras stop at what leaves the Sheets payable (Owl x2 + the look). MTG_REPEAT_EXTRAS_RESERVE=0 -> 1 short plan.
